The '''Mabari''' were an ancient order of [[Zolander]]<ref name="FF53" /> [[Soldier/Legends|warrior-knights]] from [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]], a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Sanbra">{{GamerCite|10|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Clawdites}}</ref> Rooted in the teachings of the [[Jal Shey]] [[Monk/Legends|monk]]s,<ref name="Scum">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> the Mabari were renowned as the best warriors on Zolan,<ref name="FF53" /> serving as protectors of the planet's religious rulers.<ref name="FF49">{{FactFile|49|CLA 1-4|Clawdites}}</ref> The order maintained highly selective membership, accepting very few<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|272|Mabari}}</ref> of the most promising Clawdite recruits for their rigorous martial training.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Over time, the Mabari adapted to incorporate modern technology and weaponry.<ref name="FF49" />

[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], a Clawdite who questioned her peoples' religious traditions,<ref name="Wesell">{{GamerCite|10|Zam Wesell: Clawdite Assassin}}</ref> was raised by the Mabari<ref name="Scum" /> and achieved their third level of combat mastery.<ref name="Wesell" /> An adherent of the Mabari discipline,<ref name="TCSWE" /> she often adorned herself with traditional [[Mabari script/Legends|Mabari inscriptions]] and emblems, including a [[Cape/Legends|cape]] seal—an ancient artifact<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> bearing third-level fighter markings,<ref name="CVD" /> as well as Mabari combat [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]]<ref name="FF53" /> and a Mabari [[Body glove/Legends|bodysuit]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CVD" /> the Mabari further restricted Clawdite membership due to religious and societal prejudices, as well as fears that a large, trained Clawdite faction could overthrow the Zolander government. Clawdite members were closely monitored, and those who left the order were pressured to leave the planet.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mabari were first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="AOTCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> published on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref>

The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 49|fourty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine, describes Zam Wesell, a Clawdite, as having been raised by the Mabari.<ref name="FF49" /> However, the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 53|fifty-third issue]] of the magazine depicts the Mabari as xenophobic toward Clawdites, refusing to admit "sinners" into their ranks and leading Wesell to flee Zolan after completing her training to avoid persecution.<ref name="FF53" /> Later, ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' clarified that the Mabari did admit Clawdites, albeit in small numbers.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> This article adheres to the later source.
